_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_books" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "author_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "genre_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "description" TEXT NULL, "cover_url" TEXT NULL, "cover_path" TEXT NULL, "cover_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "publish_date" INTEGER NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "source_url" TEXT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NULL, "file_size" INTEGER NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "reading_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "detected_encoding" TEXT NULL, "encoding_confidence" REAL NULL, "encoding_source" TEXT NULL, "user_forced_encoding" TEXT NULL, "storage_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'internal', "external_uri" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "authors" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "book_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "book_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_series" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "series_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence_number" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "series_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "genres" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "downloads" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "book_title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "format" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_path" TEXT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "downloaded_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_progress" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "chapter_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "paragraph_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "local_offset" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "progress_percent" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "chapter_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "text_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_pages" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_read" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bookmarks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chapter_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paragraph_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_offset" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "selected_text" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chapter_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paragraph_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_offset" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "highlight_color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#FFEB3B', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quotes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chapter_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paragraph_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "selected_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_context" TEXT NULL, "after_context" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "query" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "searched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "book_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_collections" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "collection_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "collection_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "chapters_read" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "per_book_settings" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "settings_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#2196F3', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_tags" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_time" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reading_time_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "text_highlights" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chapter_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chapter_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "block_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL, "selected_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'yellow', "note_text" TEXT NULL, "is_orphaned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_orphaned" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_saved_books_content_hash ON saved_books (content_hash)
CREATE INDEX idx_downloads_bookId ON downloads (book_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_bookmarks_bookId ON bookmarks (book_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_notes_bookId ON notes (book_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_quotes_bookId ON quotes (book_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_book_collections_collection_id ON book_collections (collection_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_reading_sessions_bookId ON reading_sessions (book_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_book_tags_tag_id ON book_tags (tag_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_text_highlights_bookId ON text_highlights (book_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_text_highlights_chapterId ON text_highlights (chapter_id)
